description: We are RETAL SPACE EXPLORERS, a family innovation team from Bahrain led by 10-year-old Retal, alongside her sisters Aseel and Basant, supported by our parents. We love coding, AI, game development, and space exploration. Our goal is to create an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that makes space science fun and accessible to children. We welcome collaboration in space science, research, and simulation design. Together, we dream, learn, explore, and innovate!
